expectations.text: Does not treat instructor letters or refundable reservations as authorized recurring sales
expectations.evidence: “without binding purchases”; “buyer authority and overlap with other groups are unknown. Neither establishes subscription demand.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes first assisted use from retention and notes the monthly repeat opportunity has not occurred
expectations.evidence: “Eight free, founder-assisted trials show initial use”; “None has reached another monthly rota: retention is unobserved, not zero.”

expectations.text: Recommends a bounded next commitment rather than treating evidence as sufficient to hire two engineers
expectations.evidence: “Do not hire two engineers yet”; “Proposed cap: this cohort and existing manual delivery only, with a founder-hours ceiling agreed before starting.”

expectations.text: Chooses a test of buyer commitment or repeat value with eligible participants, measurement denominator and observation window
expectations.evidence: “Reach the eight trial gyms’ authorized owners”; “paying gyms/offered, and repeat paid exports/paying gyms whose next monthly rota is due”; “review after each eligible gym’s second opportunity.”

expectations.text: Includes an inconclusive outcome and labels any new threshold as a justified proposal rather than a universal benchmark
expectations.evidence: “Proposed rules: repeated paid value justifies a bounded follow-on pilot”; “Unreached owners or cycles not yet due are inconclusive. No numerical hiring threshold is defensible yet.” Gates are explicitly proposed and grounded in the stated gap that “owner willingness to pay £80/month is untested”; no arbitrary new numeric benchmark is introduced.

expectations.text: Does not invent market facts, costs or profitable unit economics and stays within 700 body words
expectations.evidence: “Sustainable delivery and acquisition economics are also unknown”; asks “What delivery costs, founder-hours ceiling and hiring economics must this support?” Supplied body count: 335, below 700; no invented market/cost/profit facts.

suggestions.reason: Current assertions allow qualitative “repeated paid value” and “consistent informed refusals” without a reproducible continue/reshape rule. Consider requiring a predeclared context-justified rule or an explicit step for agreeing it before the test.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
